items: The compliance officer ____ explained the revised reporting rule to all department heads.
The emphatic pronoun 'herself' follows the subject to stress that the compliance officer personally explained the rule.
After missing the filing deadline, the account manager blamed ____ for not checking the calendar.
The account manager is both the person assigning blame and the person receiving it, so the reflexive pronoun 'herself' is required.
The warehouse robots position ____ at the charging stations when their batteries run low.
The robots perform the positioning action on themselves, so the reflexive pronoun 'themselves' is required.
Mr. Alvarez completed the customs declaration ____ instead of asking the shipping agent to do it.
'Himself' emphasizes that Mr. Alvarez personally completed the declaration.
The training coordinator ____ will lead the orientation session for the new sales representatives.
The emphatic pronoun 'herself' stresses that the training coordinator personally will lead the session.
The delegates seated ____ near the front of the conference room before the presentation began.
The delegates are both the people seating and the people being seated, so 'themselves' is required.
We prepared ____ for the client meeting by reviewing the latest contract terms.
The subject 'we' and the object of 'prepared' refer to the same group, so 'ourselves' is required.
The self-service kiosk turns ____ back on after the nightly software update is completed.
The kiosk acts on itself in the phrasal construction 'turn itself back on', so 'itself' is required.
The auditors ____ requested additional evidence for the travel-expense transactions.
The emphatic pronoun 'themselves' stresses that the auditors personally requested the evidence.
Ms. Lee excused ____ from the budget meeting to handle an urgent customer complaint.
Ms. Lee is both the person excusing and the person being excused, so 'herself' is required.
You should allow ____ at least thirty minutes to complete the online compliance module.
The person addressed is both the one allowing time and the recipient of that time, so 'yourself' is required.
The engineering team diagnosed the intermittent fault ____ without assistance from the manufacturer.
'Themselves' emphasizes that the engineering team members personally diagnosed the fault without outside help.
I assigned ____ the task of confirming the supplier's revised delivery date.
The speaker assigns the task to the same person who is the subject, so the reflexive pronoun 'myself' is required.
The business partners kept the final price concession to ____ until the contract was signed.
The fixed pattern 'keep something to themselves' requires the reflexive pronoun for information retained within the same group.
The climate-control unit adjusts ____ according to the number of people in the meeting room.
The unit is both the thing doing the adjusting and the thing being adjusted, so 'itself' is required.
The new hires introduced ____ during the virtual orientation before joining their assigned teams.
The new hires are both the people introducing and the people being introduced, so 'themselves' is required.
The company founder ____ negotiated the licensing agreement with the overseas distributor.
The emphatic pronoun 'herself' stresses that the founder personally negotiated the agreement.
Our department prides ____ on responding to technical inquiries within one business day.
The expression 'pride itself on' requires the reflexive pronoun because the department takes pride in its own performance.
Mr. Singh found ____ managing the branch temporarily after the director took medical leave.
In the pattern 'find oneself doing something', the subject and object refer to the same person, so 'himself' is required.
Please make ____ available for a brief call with the legal team tomorrow morning.
The fixed pattern 'make yourself available' requires the reflexive pronoun when addressing one person.
The directors ____ approved the revised investment policy after reviewing the risk report.
The emphatic pronoun 'themselves' stresses that the directors personally approved the policy.
Ms. Ito taught ____ basic spreadsheet macros by working through the internal training materials.
Ms. Ito learned without another teacher, so the reflexive pronoun 'herself' is required after 'taught'.
We found ____ waiting for clearance from the compliance office before the campaign could launch.
In the pattern 'find ourselves doing something', the subject and object refer to the same group.
The document scanner cleans ____ automatically after every five hundred pages.
The scanner performs the cleaning action on itself, so the reflexive pronoun 'itself' is required.
I ____ verified the serial numbers before the equipment was released to the customer.
The emphatic pronoun 'myself' stresses that the speaker personally verified the serial numbers.
